## Oxford Economics

```{r setup-oxford, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("tasks/oxford/charts/index.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))

# Load benchmark-helper for in_oxford flag
source(here::here("core/R/benchmark-helper.R"))

# Fallback: check if Oxford CSVs exist (in case in_oxford flag is stale)
if (!exists("in_oxford") || !in_oxford) {
  oxford_csvs <- list.files(tabular_dir, pattern = "_oxford_", full.names = FALSE)
  in_oxford <- length(oxford_csvs) > 0
}

hues <- c("#000000", "dark grey") %>% setNames(c(city, "Benchmark - Oxford"))

# Load CSVs produced by oxford/datacollection.R
if (in_oxford) {
  pop_dist_group <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_oxford_pop_dist.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  pop_dist_structure <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_oxford_age_structure.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  national_shares_long <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_oxford_national_shares.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  pop_growth_years <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_oxford_pop_growth.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  emp_growth_years <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_oxford_emp_growth.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  gdp_growth_years <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_oxford_gdp_growth.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  emp_longitude <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_oxford_emp.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  gdp_longitude <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_oxford_gdp.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  gdppc <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_oxford_gdppc.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  gdppc_longitude <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_oxford_gdppc_timeseries.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  emp_shares2 <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_oxford_emp_sectors.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  emp_shares <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_oxford_emp_sectors_individual.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  gva_shares2 <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_oxford_gva_sectors.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  gva_shares <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_oxford_gva_sectors_individual.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  incomes_city2 <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_oxford_incomes.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())
  incomes <- tryCatch(read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_oxford_incomes_all.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) tibble())

  # Restore factor ordering lost in CSV
  # Group factor: focus city first, Benchmark second (affects bar dodge order
  # and position_nudge targeting on shares charts)
  .restore_group <- function(df) {
    if (nrow(df) > 0 && "Group" %in% names(df)) {
      df <- df %>% mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = c(city, "Benchmark - Oxford")))
    }
    df
  }
  pop_dist_group <- .restore_group(pop_dist_group)
  national_shares_long <- .restore_group(national_shares_long)
  pop_growth_years <- .restore_group(pop_growth_years)
  emp_growth_years <- .restore_group(emp_growth_years)
  gdp_growth_years <- .restore_group(gdp_growth_years)
  emp_longitude <- .restore_group(emp_longitude)
  gdp_longitude <- .restore_group(gdp_longitude)
  gdppc <- .restore_group(gdppc)
  gdppc_longitude <- .restore_group(gdppc_longitude)
  emp_shares2 <- .restore_group(emp_shares2)
  emp_shares <- .restore_group(emp_shares)
  gva_shares2 <- .restore_group(gva_shares2)
  gva_shares <- .restore_group(gva_shares)
  incomes <- .restore_group(incomes)
  incomes_city2 <- .restore_group(incomes_city2)

  if (nrow(pop_dist_group) > 0 && "order" %in% names(pop_dist_group)) {
    pop_dist_group <- pop_dist_group %>% arrange(order) %>%
      mutate(Age_Bracket = factor(Age_Bracket, levels = unique(Age_Bracket)))
  }
  if (nrow(pop_dist_structure) > 0) {
    pop_dist_structure <- pop_dist_structure %>%
      mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Young", "Working", "65+")))
  }
  if (nrow(national_shares_long) > 0) {
    # Restore Location order: focus city first, then benchmark cities by
    # descending Population Share (matches collection.R line 170)
    loc_order <- national_shares_long %>%
      filter(Indicator == "Population Share") %>%
      arrange(desc(Group), desc(Percentage)) %>%
      pull(Location) %>% unique()
    national_shares_long <- national_shares_long %>%
      mutate(Location = factor(Location, levels = loc_order),
             Indicator = factor(Indicator, levels = c("GDP Share", "Employment Share", "Population Share")))
  }
  if (nrow(emp_shares2) > 0) {
    sector_order <- emp_shares2 %>% filter(Group == city) %>% arrange(desc(Share)) %>% pull(Indicator) %>% unique()
    emp_shares2 <- emp_shares2 %>% mutate(Indicator = factor(Indicator, levels = sector_order))
    if (nrow(emp_shares) > 0) emp_shares <- emp_shares %>% mutate(Indicator = factor(Indicator, levels = sector_order))
    if (nrow(gva_shares2) > 0) gva_shares2 <- gva_shares2 %>% mutate(Indicator = factor(Indicator, levels = sector_order))
    if (nrow(gva_shares) > 0) gva_shares <- gva_shares %>% mutate(Indicator = factor(Indicator, levels = sector_order))
  }
  ylims_shares <- if (nrow(emp_shares2) > 0 && nrow(gva_shares2) > 0) c(0, max(c(emp_shares2$Share, gva_shares2$Share), na.rm = T) * 1.1) else c(0, 0.4)

  # Restore Band factor levels lost in CSV
  if (nrow(incomes_city2) > 0) {
    band_levels <- c("Under $5K", "$7.5K-10K", "$10K-20K", "$20K-35K", "$35K-70K", "Over $70K")
    incomes_city2 <- incomes_city2 %>% mutate(Band = factor(Band, levels = band_levels))
  }
  if (nrow(incomes) > 0) {
    incomes <- incomes %>% mutate(Band = factor(Band, levels = unique(Band)))
  }
}
```

```{r oxford-check, results='asis'}
  cat("**City is not in Oxford Economics database — skipping economic indicators.**\n\n")
}
```

### Population Growth (Oxford)

```{r chart-oxford-pop-growth, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: chart-oxford-pop-growth
#| results: asis

if (in_oxford && nrow(pop_growth_years) > 0 && "Value" %in% names(pop_growth_years)) {
  pop_oxford_city <- pop_growth_years %>%
    filter(Location == city) %>%
    mutate(Population = Value * 1000, Source = "Oxford") %>%
    arrange(Year)

  if (nrow(pop_oxford_city) > 0) {
    oxford_city_plot <- ggplot(pop_oxford_city, aes(x = Year, y = Population)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_point(size = 1.5) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = seq(min(pop_oxford_city$Year), max(pop_oxford_city$Year), 5),
        minor_breaks = seq(min(pop_oxford_city$Year), max(pop_oxford_city$Year), 1)) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(0, max(pop_oxford_city$Population)),
        labels = scales::label_comma(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()),
        expand = expansion(c(0, .1))) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = paste0(city, " population growth, ", min(pop_oxford_city$Year), "–", max(pop_oxford_city$Year)),
           x = "", y = "Population") +
      theme(
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = .125, color = "dark gray"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = .125, linetype = 2, color = "dark gray"))

    ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "oxford-pop-growth.png"),
           plot = oxford_city_plot, device = "png",
           width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
    print(oxford_city_plot)
    cat("\n\n")

    print_paged_df(pop_oxford_city %>% select(Year, Population, Source))
  }
}
```

### Population (Oxford)

```{r chart-oxford-pop-line, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: chart-oxford-pop-line
#| results: asis

if (in_oxford && nrow(pop_growth_years) > 0 && "Value" %in% names(pop_growth_years)) {
  # Oxford stores population in thousands
  pop_oxford <- pop_growth_years %>%
    mutate(Population = Value * 1000, Source = "Oxford")

  print_text("Total population in 2021 (Oxford)")
  pop_oxford %>% slice_max(Year) %>% arrange(-Population) %>%
    select(Group, Location, Population, Source) %>%
    print_paged_df()

  multi_city_pop_plot <- ggplot(pop_oxford) +
    geom_line(aes(x = Year, y = Population, group = Location, color = Group)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = hues) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = .125, color = "dark gray"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = .125, linetype = 2, color = "dark gray"),
          axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
          legend.position = "none") +
    labs(title = paste("Population of", city, "and benchmark cities"), x = "") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA), expand = c(0,0),
      labels = scales::label_comma(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(min(pop_oxford$Year), 2021, 5),
      minor_breaks = seq(2000, 2030, 1),
      limits = c(min(pop_oxford$Year), 2028), expand = c(0,0)) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = \(x) subset(x, Year == 2021),
      aes(label = Location, x = 2021, y = Population, color = Group),
      hjust = 0, size = 3, xlim = c(2021.25, 2030), box.padding = 0.05,
      direction = "y", segment.linetype = "dotted")

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "oxford-pop-line.png"), device = "png", plot = multi_city_pop_plot,
         width = 5, height = 4.6, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(multi_city_pop_plot)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

### Population Density (Oxford)

```{r chart-oxford-pop-density, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: chart-oxford-pop-density
#| results: asis

# Build an all-Oxford density scatter:
#   - benchmark cities: use Area_km + Population already in density_benchmark.csv
#     (those rows are already Oxford-sourced)
#   - main city: override Population with Oxford latest year (from pop_growth_years),
#     keep Area_km from density_benchmark (AOI area)
density_oxford <- tryCatch(
  read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_density_benchmark.csv")),
           show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) tibble())

if (in_oxford && nrow(density_oxford) > 0 && nrow(pop_growth_years) > 0 &&
    "Value" %in% names(pop_growth_years)) {
  # Latest Oxford year for main city
  city_oxford_latest <- pop_growth_years %>%
    filter(Location == city) %>%
    slice_max(Year, n = 1)

  if (nrow(city_oxford_latest) > 0) {
    city_row <- density_oxford %>% filter(Location == city)
    if (nrow(city_row) > 0 && !is.na(city_row$Area_km[1]) && city_row$Area_km[1] > 0) {
      density_oxford <- density_oxford %>% filter(Location != city)
      city_row$Year <- city_oxford_latest$Year[1]
      city_row$Population <- city_oxford_latest$Value[1] * 1000
      city_row$Source <- "Oxford"
      city_row$Method <- "Oxford"
      city_row$Density <- city_row$Population / city_row$Area_km
      density_oxford <- bind_rows(city_row, density_oxford)
    }
  }

  # Keep only rows with valid density
  density_oxford <- density_oxford %>% filter(!is.na(Density) & Density > 0)

  if (nrow(density_oxford) > 0) {
    bm_groups <- setdiff(unique(density_oxford$Group), city)
    hues_density <- c("#000000", rep("dark grey", length(bm_groups))) %>%
      setNames(c(city, bm_groups))

    density_oxford_plot <- density_oxford %>%
      ggplot() +
      geom_point(aes(x = Population, y = Density, color = Group)) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        aes(x = Population, y = Density, label = Location, color = Group),
        box.padding = 0.25, min.segment.length = 0.001, point.padding = 1,
        segment.linetype = "dotted") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = .125, color = "dark gray"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = .125, linetype = 2, color = "dark gray")) +
      labs(title = "Population density comparison (Oxford)",
           y = bquote('Population density, people per '~km^2),
           x = "Population") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma(),
                         expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .03))) +
      scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
      scale_color_manual(values = hues_density) +
      expand_limits(y = 0)

    ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "oxford-pop-density-scatter.png"),
           plot = density_oxford_plot, device = "png",
           width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
    print(density_oxford_plot)
    cat("\n\n")

    density_oxford %>% arrange(-Density) %>%
      select(any_of(c("Group", "Location", "Year", "Population", "Area_km", "Density", "Source"))) %>%
      print_paged_df()
  }
}
```

### Age Structure

```{r chart-oxford-age-structure, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: chart-oxford-age-structure

if (in_oxford && nrow(pop_dist_structure) > 0) {
  print_paged_df(pop_dist_structure %>% mutate(Source = "Oxford"))

  hues_age_structure <- c("black", "dark grey", "dark grey") %>%
    setNames(c("Working", "Young", "65+"))
  hues_age_structure[1] <- "#000000"

  pop_dist_plot <- ggplot(pop_dist_structure) +
    geom_area(aes(x = Year, y = Percent, fill = forcats::fct_rev(Group)), alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(pop_dist_structure, Year == 2021),
      aes(label = paste0(Group, "\n", scales::label_percent()(Percent)),
          x = 2021, y = (pct_sum - Percent/2), color = forcats::fct_rev(Group)),
      hjust = 0, size = 2.5, xlim = c(2021.25, 2025), box.padding = 0.05,
      segment.linetype = "dotted") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = c(0,0)) +

      minor_breaks = 2000:2025,
      breaks = c(2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020),
      limits = c(2000, 2025), expand = c(0,0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = hues_age_structure) +
    scale_color_manual(values = hues_age_structure) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
          legend.position = "none") +
    labs(title = "Age Structure, 2000-2021",
         y = "Percent of Population",
         x = "Year")

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "oxford-age-structure-area.png"), plot = pop_dist_plot, device = "png",
         width = 4, height = 3.5, units = "in", dpi = "print")

}
```

### GDP, Population, Employment Growth

```{r chart-oxford-growth-tables, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: chart-oxford-growth-tables
#| results: asis

if (in_oxford) {
  if (nrow(pop_growth_years) > 0) {
    pop_growth2 <- pop_growth_years %>%
      group_by(Group, Location) %>%
      summarize(`Population Growth` = mean(Growth, na.rm = T), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(Source = "Oxford") %>%
      arrange(desc(`Population Growth`))
    print_text("Population growth from 2000 to 2021")
    print_paged_df(pop_growth2)
  }

  if (nrow(emp_growth_years) > 0) {
    emp_growth <- emp_growth_years %>%
      group_by(Group, Location) %>%
      summarize(`Employment Growth` = mean(Growth, na.rm = T), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(`Employment Growth`))
    print_text("Employment growth from 2000 to 2021")
    print_paged_df(emp_growth)

    print_text("Employment growth in focus city for each year")
    filter(emp_growth_years, Location == city) %>% print_paged_df()
  }

  if (nrow(gdp_growth_years) > 0) {
    gdp_growth <- gdp_growth_years %>%
      group_by(Group, Location) %>%
      summarize(`GDP Growth` = mean(Growth, na.rm = T), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(`GDP Growth`))
    print_text("GDP growth from 2000 to 2021")
    print_paged_df(gdp_growth)

    print_text("GDP growth in focus city for each year")
    print_paged_df(filter(gdp_growth_years, Location == city))
  }
}
```

```{r chart-oxford-gdp-line, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(min(gdp_longitude$Year), 2021, 5),
      minor_breaks = seq(2000,2030,1),
      limits = c(min(gdp_longitude$Year), 2028), expand = c(0,0)) +
    geom_text_repel(data = \(x) subset(x, Year == 2021), aes(label = Location, x = 2022, y = `GDP`, color = Group),
                    hjust = 0, size = 3, xlim = c(2021.25, 2030), box.padding = 0.05,
                    direction = "y", segment.linetype = "dotted")

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "oxford-gdp-line.png"), device = "png",
         width = 5, height = 4.6, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(multi_city_gdp_plot)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

### GDP per Capita

```{r chart-oxford-gdppc, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: chart-oxford-gdppc
#| results: asis

if (in_oxford && nrow(gdppc) > 0) {
  gdppc_plot <- ggplot(gdppc) +
    geom_col(aes(y = fct_reorder(Location, -`GDP per capita`), x = `GDP per capita`, fill = Group)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = .125, color = "dark gray"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = .125, linetype = 2, color = "dark gray"),
          axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
          legend.position = "none") +
    labs(title = paste("GDP per capita in", city, "and benchmark cities"),
         y = "City") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()), expand = expansion(mult = c(0,0.05)))

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "oxford-gdp-per-capita.png"), plot = gdppc_plot, device = "png",
         width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(gdppc_plot)
  cat("\n\n")

  print_paged_df(subset(gdppc, Location == city))

  if (nrow(gdppc_longitude) > 0) {
    gdppc_longitude %>%
      slice_max(Year, n = 10) %>%
      summarize(`growth_pct` = mean(growth_pct), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(`growth_pct`)) %>%
      print_paged_df()
  }
}
```

### Economic Inequality

```{r chart-oxford-incomes-area, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: chart-oxford-incomes-area
#| results: asis

if (in_oxford && nrow(incomes) > 0) {
  household_incomes_bar_plot <- incomes %>% group_by(Location) %>%
    subset(Year == 2021) %>%
    mutate(Percent = Households / sum(Households), sum = sum(Households)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(Group, Band) %>%
    summarize(Percent = median(Percent), .groups = "drop") %>%
    ggplot(aes(y = Band, x = Percent, fill = Group)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = hues) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black")) +
    labs(title = "Household income distribution (PPP constant 2015 dollars)",
         x = "Percent of Households",
         y = "Income Group")
  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "oxford-household-incomes-bar.png"), plot = household_incomes_bar_plot, device = "png",
         width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(household_incomes_bar_plot)
  cat("\n\n")
}

if (in_oxford && nrow(incomes_city2) > 0) {
  household_incomes_area_plot <- ggplot(incomes_city2) +
    geom_area(aes(x = Year, y = Percent, fill = forcats::fct_rev(Band)), color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = \(x) subset(x, Year == 2021),
      aes(label = Band, x = 2021, y = (pct_sum - Percent/2), color = forcats::fct_rev(Band)),
      hjust = 0, size = 3, xlim = c(2021.25, 2030), box.padding = 0.02) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0,0))) +
    scale_x_continuous(minor_breaks = 2002:2030, limits = c(min(incomes_city2$Year), max(incomes_city2$Year) + 3),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0,0))) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"), legend.position = "none") +
    labs(title = paste0("Household income distribution, ", min(incomes_city2$Year), "-2021 (PPP constant 2015 dollars)"),
         y = "Percent of Households",
         x = "Year")

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "oxford-household-incomes-area.png"), plot = household_incomes_area_plot, device = "png",
         width = 4, height = 3.5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(household_incomes_area_plot)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
